findings.evidence: The smooth section explicitly requires bounded self-adjoint idempotents. This supplies the adjoint identities and positive functional calculus used downstream.
The proof now solves V prime=-VK and proves both VU=I and UV=I, using uniqueness for W prime=KW-WK. Unitarity is then correctly inferred from invertibility and U*U=I.
The based-loop multiplication convention explicitly traverses gamma_1 before gamma_2 in gamma_2 gamma_1, matching rightmost-first transport products.
The closed-path corollary now assumes C2 operator-norm regularity on the compact interval. This implies the direct-rotation theorem hypotheses and Lipschitz K for the sampled-transport theorem.

Zero projections are explicitly allowed in this section, covering P=0 or I. Both statement and proof of the direct-rotation proposition use max({0} union norm differences), covering an empty complete family on the zero space.
The parameter domain is explicitly [0,T] with T>=0, and T=0 uses identity empty products.
